staticRisks.title: Legacy calibration consumes unverified SELF_REPORTED outcomes via PredictionResult.actualResult
staticRisks.impact: Calibration and drift suggestions can be trained on contaminated truth while training-data and monitoring paths use verified-only outcomes. This creates conflicting truth regimes inside the same prediction system.
staticRisks.recommendation: Gate all calibration/drift inputs through canonical verified outcome records only. Stop using PredictionResult.actualResult as calibration truth unless its provenance is verified.

staticRisks.title: Served probability is modified after Platt calibration
staticRisks.impact: The number shown to users is no longer the same quantity that was calibrated if later major, feeder, round, and school multipliers materially move it.
staticRisks.recommendation: Either calibrate the final served probability after all deterministic adjustments, or move post-calibration modifiers into the calibratable model input space.

staticRisks.title: Outward-facing 95% accuracy claim conflicts with current verified baseline and SOP
staticRisks.impact: The current claim exposes the product to trust and governance risk because the repo baseline shows zero verified ADMITTED/REJECTED outcomes in the last 365 days.
staticRisks.recommendation: Immediately replace marketing copy with non-quantified language until prediction gate passes with verified sample threshold support.

staticRisks.title: Quick-match writes v1-stats rows into PredictionResult and can be mixed into accuracy reporting
staticRisks.impact: Without explicit source segmentation, the audit can combine a heuristic quick-match branch with the main prediction workflow and produce misleading aggregate metrics.
staticRisks.recommendation: Split formal reporting by source and modelVersion, and exclude quick-match from any headline prediction accuracy number.
